description_en: Submits a preset template analysis job
description_zh: 提交预置模板分析作业
name: SubmitAnalysisJob

parameters.help_en:
The job input, which is a JSON object. You must grant the read permissions on the bucket to ApsaraVideo Media Processing on the bucket authorization page in the OSS console. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/29253.html.

The region of the OSS bucket must be the same as the region of MPS
parameters.help_zh:
作业输入，JSON对象。需在OSS控制台Bucket授权页面将Bucket读权限授权给媒体转码服务。更多信息请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/29253.html。

OSS的地域需要与当前MPS所在地域保持一致
parameters.name: input

parameters.help_en: The configuration of the template analysis job. Set the parameters as needed. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/29253.html
parameters.help_zh: 模板分析作业配置，根据您的实际需要按需设置。更多参数信息请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/29253.html
parameters.name: analysis_config

parameters.help_en: The custom user data. It can contain Chinese and English characters, digits, and hyphens (-). It cannot start with a special character. The maximum length is 1,024 bytes
parameters.help_zh: 用户自定义数据，可以使用中英文、数字、中划线（-）等，不能以特殊字符开头，最大长度1024个字节
parameters.name: user_data

parameters.help_en: The ID of the MPS queue. You can view the ID by choosing MPS Console > Global Settings > Pipelines. If asynchronous notification is required, make sure that an available message topic is bound to this MPS queue
parameters.help_zh: 管道ID，可以通过MPS控制台>全局设置>管道查看。如果需要异步通知，须保证此管道绑定了可用的消息主题
parameters.name: pipeline_id

parameters.help_en:
The transcoding priority of the job in its corresponding MPS queue.

Valid values: [1,10]. A value of 10 indicates the highest priority.
Default value: 6
parameters.help_zh:
任务在其对应管道内的转码优先级。

取值范围：[1,10]，10为最高优先级。
默认值：6
parameters.name: priority

AnalysisJob.description_en: The template analysis job for system preset templates
AnalysisJob.description_zh: 系统预置模板分析作业

Height.description_en:
The height after cropping.
If Mode is set to Auto or None, this value does not take effect
Height.description_zh:
裁切后高。

若Mode为Auto或None，则此值失效

Left.description_en:
The left margin for cropping.
If Mode is set to Auto or None, this value does not take effect
Left.description_zh:
裁切左边距。

若Mode为Auto或None，则此值失效

Mode.description_en:
The cropping method. Valid values:
Auto: Automatic. This is the default value.
Force: Forced.
None: No forced cropping
Mode.description_zh:
裁切方式。取值：

Auto：自动（默认）。
Force：强制。
None：强制不做

Top.description_en:
The top margin for cropping.
If Mode is set to Auto or None, this value does not take effect
Top.description_zh:
裁切上边距。

若Mode为Auto或None，则此值失效

Width.description_en:
The width after cropping.
If Mode is set to Auto or None, this value does not take effect
Width.description_zh:
裁切后宽。

若Mode为Auto或None，则此值失效

Deinterlace.description_en:
The forced scan mode determination. Valid values:
Auto: Automatic.
Force: Forced deinterlacing.
None: No forced deinterlacing
Deinterlace.description_zh:
强制扫描模式判定。

Auto：自动。
Force：强制做deinterlace。
None：强制不做deinterlace

MethodStreaming.description_en:
The playback method. Valid values:
network: Online.
local: Local.
Default value: network
MethodStreaming.description_zh:
播放方式。

network：在线。

local：本地。

默认值：network

Code.description_en: The error code returned when the analysis fails. This parameter is not returned when the analysis is successful
Code.description_zh: 分析失败时错误码。分析成功时不返回此参数

CreationTime.description_en: The time when the job was added. The time is displayed in UTC and follows the ISO 8601 standard in the YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ format
CreationTime.description_zh: 作业添加时间，采用 ISO 8601 格式的 UTC 时间，格式为 YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ

MNSMessageResult.description_en: The result of the MNS notification sent to the user when the job is completed
MNSMessageResult.description_zh: MNS通知用户作业完成的结果

ErrorCode.description_en: The error code returned when the analysis fails. This parameter is not returned when the analysis is successful
ErrorCode.description_zh: 失败时错误码。分析成功时不返回此参数

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned when the analysis fails. This parameter is not returned when the analysis is successful
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 失败时错误信息。分析成功时不返回此参数
ErrorMessage.example: The resource operated \"PipelineId\" cannot be found

MessageId.description_en: The message ID returned when the analysis is successful. This parameter is not returned when the analysis fails
MessageId.description_zh: 成功时消息ID。分析失败时不返回此参数

Message.description_en: The error message returned when the analysis fails
Message.example: The resource operated \"PipelineId\" cannot be found

Priority.description_en:
The priority of the job in the corresponding MPS queue.
Valid values: [1,10]. A value of 10 indicates the highest priority.
Default value: 10
Priority.description_zh:
任务在其对应管道内的优先级。

取值范围：[1,10]。10为最高优先级。

默认值：10

State.description_en:
The job status. Valid values:
Submitted: The job is submitted.
Analyzing: The job is being analyzed.
Success: The analysis succeeded.
Fail: The analysis failed
State.description_zh:
作业状态。

Submitted：已提交。

Analyzing：分析中。

Success：分析成功。

Fail：分析失败

Template.description_en: The list of preset templates output by the job
Template.description_zh: 作业输出的预置模板列表

items.description_en: The details of the preset templates output by the job
items.description_zh: 作业输出的预置模板详细信息

Bitrate.description_en:
The audio bitrate of the output file.
Unit: Kbps.
Default value: 128
Bitrate.description_zh:
输出文件的音频码率。

单位：Kbps。
默认值：128

Channels.description_en: The number of audio channels. Default value: 2

Codec.description_en: The audio codec format. Default value: aac
Codec.description_zh: 音频编解码格式。默认值：aac

Profile.description_en: The audio encoding preset. When Codec is set to aac, valid values are aac_low, aac_he, aac_he_v2, aac_ld, and aac_eld
Profile.description_zh: 音频编码预置。当Codec为aac时可取值：aac_low、aac_he、aac_he_v2、aac_ld、aac_eld

Samplerate.description_en:
The sampling rate.
Unit: Hz.
Default value: 44100
Samplerate.description_zh:
采样率。

单位：Hz。
默认值：44100

FinalDelay.description_en: The loop interval of the GIF. Unit: hundredths of a second. For example, 500 indicates an interval of 5 seconds
FinalDelay.description_zh: gif的loop间隔，单位为百分之一秒，比如500代表间隔为5秒

Loop.description_en: The number of loops for GIF and WebP. By default, no loop is performed
Loop.description_zh: gif与webp循环次数，默认不循环

State.description_en:
The template status. Valid values:
Normal: Normal.
Deleted: Deleted
State.description_zh:
模板的状态。

Normal：正常。

Deleted：已删除

TransMode.description_en: The transcoding mode. Valid values: onepass, twopass, and CBR. Default value: onepass

Bitrate.description_en: The average video bitrate. Unit: Kbps

Max.description_en: The upper limit of the total bitrate. Unit: Kbps

Min.description_en: The lower limit of the total bitrate. Unit: Kbps

Bufsize.description_en:
The buffer size.
Unit: Kb.
Default value: 6000
Bufsize.description_zh:
缓冲区大小。

单位：Kb。
默认值：6000

Codec.description_en: The codec format. Default value: H.264

Crf.description_en:
The constant rate factor (CRF) for bitrate and quality control.
Default value: If the encoding format is H.264, the default value is 23. If the encoding format is H.265, the default value is 26.
If Crf is set, the Bitrate setting does not take effect
Crf.description_zh:
码率-质量控制因子。

默认值：编码格式为H264，默认值为23。编码格式为H265，默认值为26。

如果设置了Crf，则Bitrate的设置失效

Degrain.description_en: The strength of the independent denoising algorithm

Fps.description_en:
The frame rate.
If the frame rate of the input file exceeds 60, the value 60 is used.
Default value: Frame rate of the input file
Fps.description_zh:
帧率。

当输入文件帧率超过60时取60。
默认值：取输入文件帧率

Gop.description_en: The maximum number of frames between keyframes. Default value: 250
Gop.description_zh: 关键帧间最大帧数。默认值：250

Height.description_en:
The video height.
Unit: px.
Default value: Original video height
Height.description_zh:
视频高。
单位：px。
默认值：视频原始高度

Maxrate.description_en: The peak video bitrate. Unit: Kbps

PixFmt.description_en: The video color format. Standard color formats such as yuv420p and yuvj420p are supported
PixFmt.description_zh: 视频颜色格式。包含yuv420p，yuvj420p等标准颜色格式

Preset.description_en: The video algorithm preset. Valid values: veryfast, fast, medium, slow, and slower. Default value: medium
Preset.description_zh: 视频算法器预置。支持veryfast（超快）、fast（快）、medium（中等）、slow（慢）、slower（超慢）。默认值：medium

Profile.description_en:
The encoding profile. Valid values:
baseline: For shift devices.
main: For standard resolution devices.
high: For high resolution devices.
Default value: high
Profile.description_zh:
编码级别。

baseline：针对移动设备。
main：针对标准分辨率设备。
high：针对高分辨率设备。

默认值：high

ScanMode.description_en:
The scan mode. Valid values:
interlaced: Interlaced scanning.
progressive: Progressive scanning
ScanMode.description_zh:
扫描模式。取值：

interlaced：交叉扫描。

progressive：顺序扫描

Width.description_en:
The video width.
Unit: px.
Default value: Original video width
Width.description_zh:
视频宽。

单位：px。
默认值：视频原始宽度
